abstract: Citadel Securities analysis challenges the prevailing narrative of AI-driven labor market disruption, presenting evidence that software engineering job postings have increased 11% year-over-year as of March 2026, with limited observable disruption signals in current labor market data.
keyFindings: Software engineer job postings are rising rapidly at 11% year-over-year growth
There is little evidence of AI disruption in labor market data as of the publication date
methodology: Not specified. The excerpt suggests analysis of job posting data with year-over-year comparisons, but full methodology details are not provided in the source text.
qualifiers: Limited scope - analysis is current only 'as of today' (March 2026) and does not address whether disruption may occur in the future; excerpt notes this is counter to 'the current displacement narrative' suggesting the findings may be preliminary or subject to rapid change.
